about.h1Title: Hello there! My name is Luigi, also known as Dævel.
about.introduction: I'm a Frontend Software Engineer. I build modern interfaces using React, Angular, and TypeScript, with a pragmatic approach to code scalability.
about.frontendArchitectureDescription: I like designing frontends that stay readable as the product grows: clear components, sharp responsibilities, and technical choices that are easy to explain.
about.userExperienceDescription: I do not stop at a UI that works: I look for rhythm, hierarchy, and small details that make an interface feel natural on every screen.
about.engineeringQualityDescription: I write code with the next person in mind: type safety, performance, and maintainability are not extras, they are part of the job.
about.approachTitle: How I build frontends that do more than just hold together

experience.h1Title: Four years of shipping frontend and full-stack products that had to work in production.
experience.introduction: A timeline of the companies, roles, and problems I've worked on, from industrial automation to banking platforms and national public security systems.

highlights: Hold full autonomy over frontend design and implementation decisions, later validated with the client, within an Agile/Scrum team with clearly distributed role ownership.
Standardized frontend architecture and reusable components across React, React Native, TypeScript, Nx and RTK Query, cutting new developer onboarding time from one week to two days.
Delivered 4 end-to-end card request journeys (credit, debit, prepaid, American Express) across React web and React Native mobile for a digital banking platform serving approximately 90,000 users.

Automated the integration of 20+ REST endpoints using react-query and a custom script generating TypeScript clients from YAML specifications, applying AI-assisted development (GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate delivery and code reviews.
Improved application responsiveness by 10% through client-side cache optimization with React Query.

Sole full-stack developer on a SaaS product for a leading Italian banking client, calculating risk perimeters across companies and subsidiaries with hierarchical data representation via D3.js, owned end-to-end from design to release.

Built 20+ Spring Boot (Java) microservices supporting SaaS and banking-side products, managing relational (PostgreSQL) and non-relational (MongoDB) databases, including a predictive risk-calculation module leveraging DWH data.

Managed production deployment and monitoring on Azure across 3 environments (dev, uat, prod), sustaining up to 2 releases per day at peak; built a Bash automation script for authentication, image upload and OpenShift deployment that cut release time from 6h to 45min, adopted team-wide.
Delivered 10+ new Angular features that modernized the application's interface, automating document compilation previously performed manually by the client.

Designed and delivered 3+ standalone Angular applications for a major Italian banking client: a branch-staff card request feature, a full rewrite of an ATM security system, and a Credit-domain real-estate application.
Sole client engagement within the public security sector, delivering projects for national law enforcement bodies.
Developed and migrated a role-assignment system (Angular, Node.js/Express) from Angular 12 to 16, used by approximately 260,000 law enforcement operators nationwide.
Maintained a Java-based vehicle license plate recognition system running daily nationwide control batches, handling 10,000+ transactions per day.
Architected and built from scratch, on Azure cloud, a credential verification portal for drone pilot licenses with a national civil aviation authority, supporting 40,000+ registered operators.
Architected and built from scratch, on Azure cloud, an internal credential management system, eliminating the practice of storing credentials on unprotected personal devices.
Designed and commissioned industrial automation systems for pharmaceutical manufacturing clients, including Pfizer and AstraZeneca.
Engineered and commissioned industrial automation systems for steel manufacturing clients, including Danieli Automation and Tata Steel, prior to transitioning into software development.

followoo.description: Followoo is a privacy-first tool that allows you to analyze your Instagram relationships directly in the browser using the ZIP file provided by Instagram's official data export.

culturando.description: Culturando is a geolocated web app for sharing and discovering private book collections. It lets users publish books, search nearby volumes on a 3D map, request consultations or loans, and use AI features to catalog books from their covers while protecting privacy and location.
